text:
[LCMP.4.2] The format must satisfy:

- **Machine-readable.** Tooling (linters, dashboards, dev-loop
  scripts) consumes the report programmatically.
- **Human-renderable.** A CLI tool or default editor view
  presents the report in readable form.
- **Versioned.** A schema-version field allows tooling to
  detect incompatibility.
- **Stable.** Breaking changes follow the standard deprecation
  path; per-feature additions are non-breaking.
